ModMetaData.name: HSK Fortifications Rebalance
ModMetaData.author: Sonsalt
ModMetaData.description:
Rebalances Aoba's "Fortifications - Medieval" and "Fortifications - Industrial" for Hardcore SK + Combat Extended.
- Removes everything that duplicates HSK (concrete economy, mixer, lathe, chemistry table, generator, radio, antenna, hydrant, ENIAC, floors, own research tree, duplicate turrets, Medieval's swivel gun). - Remaining structures and turrets use HSK materials, HSK research, HSK crate-built turrets (heavy arms lathe) and HSK/CE ammunition. - Restores the HSK research tree and floor costs that Fortifications - Industrial overrides. - Works without AOBA.Framework (strips its purely visual comps).
Load after both Fortifications mods. Each part only loads if its mod is active.
